capabilityConstraintStatus: Preserve all supplied hard minimums and targets together; joint hardware feasibility and any resource budget require qualification.

acceleration.reason: Original environment has no acceleration state/dynamics; turn time is separate

capabilityConstraints.basis: Joint abstract profile selected on calibration; reach floor covers observed calibration tasks, not full profile lift range; all are design targets, not hardware measurements
capabilityConstraints.minimumScope: Pin AND Cup placements of original representative simulated rollout only

acceleration.reason: No acceleration is represented in this contract; speed and turn overhead do not establish learned acceleration.

requirements.constraint: One Pin across intake, transfer and scorer combined; one separate Cup slot. No second buffered Pin.

requirements.orientationIntent: Retain the selected Pin scoring-half orientation through pickup and transfer; verify with actual geometry and sensing.

requirements.handoffIntent: Interlock acquisition and scoring retention; preserve orientation and prevent double feeding.

requirements.interfacePreparationIntent: Prepare the next single-Pin stack interface using an independently held Cup; align its clear side and preserve existing scoring halves.

contextApproximationValidation.use: Descriptive approximation only; actual inference always executes the frozen neural policy

inference.probabilitySemantics: Descriptive context averages are not the executable policy or independent legality rules
inference.unknownContextBehavior: Execute frozen neural policy on valid in-domain observation; never replay a fixed script

strategyAwareVsBlind.meaning: Abstract capability-profile selection only; no measured or predicted mechanical-topology performance
strategyAwareVsBlind.selectionRule: Highest calibration frozen-policy score among four declared abstract simplex profiles

evidence.targetClaims: Experimental simulator sensitivity plus engineering realization hypotheses; no causal hardware minimum identified
evidence.uncertainty: 95% capability-cluster bootstrap, 2000 samples; exploratory intervals, no multiplicity adjustment

limitations: Authored abstract competition, no physical validation
Pooled intervals condition on three fixed trained policies
Marginal interventions are off the training manifold
No independent hardware feasibility claim or acceleration model
One learned family, two engineering alternatives may implement it
No generated CAD, measured robot capability, acceleration requirement or full co-optimization loop
Marginal interventions alter both observed capabilities and transitions; action noise consumption can differ across policies

policy.selection: Seed 17 chosen by fixed seed identity, not held-out score ranking
